articleTitle: Procuring MFCCs from Crema-D Dataset for Sentiment Analysis using Deep Learning Models with Hyperparameter Tuning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is indispensable for scrutinizing the convoluted characteristics of the human mind. In this paper, an attempt is made to perform a comprehensive analysis of sentiment in the CREMA-D audio dataset by relying on extracting MFCC features from the dataset. Standardization of the dataset is carried out owing to the unequal length of each file. MFCC feature extraction on the standardized dataset leads to the harvesting of attributes such as pitch, timbre, formants etc. which are crucial for the identification of each unique audio file and their corresponding sentiment. A Deep Learning based framework is proposed to carry out this examination on the dataset by executing Convoluted Neural Networks (CNN), Recurrent Neural Networks-Long Short-Term Memories (RNN-LSTM), and Recurrent Neural Networks-Transformers (RNN-Transformers) algorithms. Six classes have been employed for this analysis, which are happy, sad, fear, disgust, angry and neutral. Maximum accuracies of 56.7% and 54.0% have been obtained from CNN and RNN models respectively.

articleTitle: Automated Online Exam Proctoring System Using Computer Vision and Hybrid ML Classifier
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: Importance of online education can be seen especially during the ongoing Covid-19 when going to schools or colleges is not possible. So validity of online exams should also be maintained with respect to traditional pen-paper examinations. However, absence of invigilator makes it easy for the examinees to cheat during the exam. Though there are already many systems for online proctoring, not all educational institutes can afford them as the systems are very expensive. In this paper, we have used eye gaze and head pose estimation as the main features to design our online proctoring system. Therefore, the purpose of this paper is to use these features to create an online proctoring system using computer vision and machine learning and stop cheating attempts in exams.

articleTitle: Rose Leaf Disease Detection Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: As Bangladesh is fully dependent on agriculture so identifying the diseases of the plants will aid the farmers for better productivity. This paper elucidates the recognition of rose leaf disease which is based on deep learning algorithms. By using deep learning algorithms, the defective images of leaves can be identified precisely which may further help the farmer to identify the leaf disease accurately, and then they will immediately take precautions according to the disease. In this paper, first, we have collected the images from the nursery and labeled each disease after preprocessing them in such a way that it is fitted to the particular model that we used. Later, we have modified and implemented the CNN model compatible with our dataset to get a better outcome. By doing so, we can identify the diseased leaves 96% accurately.

articleTitle: Non-integer Controller for Autonomous Underwater Vehicle Steering Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: This paper presents a non-integer controller method founded from fractional calculus, which enhances the steering for autonomous underwater vehicles (AUV). The AUV model is presented. A fractional order proportional integral (FOPI) control technique is applied to stabilize the system steering. Using MATLAB/Simulink the fractional order controller simulation is validated and is compared to classical integer order PI controller for tracking the yaw angle for the system. Simulation results indicates that the proposed fractional controller improves the system steering with/without external disturbances being present.

articleTitle: Fine-Grained Image Generation from Bangla Text Description using Attentional Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: Generating fine-grained, realistic images from text has many applications in the visual and semantic realm. Considering that, we propose Bangla Attentional Generative Adversarial Network (AttnGAN) that allows intensified, multi-stage processing for high-resolution Bangla text-to-image generation. Our model can integrate the most specific details at different sub-regions of the image. We distinctively concentrate on the relevant words in the natural language description. This framework has achieved a better inception score of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3.58\pm .06$</tex> on the CUB dataset. For the first time, a fine-grained image is generated from Bangla text using attentional GAN. Bangla has achieved 7th position among 100 most spoken languages. This inspires us to explicitly focus on this language, which will ensure the inevitable need of many people. Moreover, Bangla has a more complex syntactic structure and less natural language processing resource that validates our work more.

articleTitle: Quadcopter Dynamic Modeling and Stability Control Design using Hardware in Loop
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: Quadcopters are widely used in military and domestic applications as they offer awesome applications in medical, military, agriculture etc. Quadcopters are compact in size and offer vertical takeoff and landing capabilities that require less space for operational activities. Because of their immense applications, many researchers have worked to minimize the operational errors to enhance its accuracy and stability. Several researchers have proposed multiple control strategies and dynamic modeling of quadcopter, but each has its perks and limitations. This paper has proposed Model Based Design is approach, Software In Loop (SIL) simulation specifically to develop quadcop-ter dynamic model and two control strategies i.e. PID controller and Pole Placement controller. LabVIEW is used as simulator to deploy quadcopter dynamics and designed control strategies. Model tests are conducted by defining trajectory for control strategies and pole placement controller showed better results. The model is then deployed on hardware and through Hardware in Loop testing, the model performance is validated.

articleTitle: D-Bot: A Food Serving Robot During Pandemic Situation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: In this paper, an autonomous mobile robot (AMR) that delivers food to patients in hospitals during COVID-19 pandemic situation was proposed. AMRs are one of the tools that can minimize direct physical contact between healthcare worker and patients to prevent infection. As some of the hospital logistic tasks are handled by the AMRs, more manpower can be distributed to more important tasks. This is a capstone project developed by a group of students from the Faculty of Engineering, at UCSI University. The project was completed with a concept design, a virtual prototype, and computer simulation of the robot.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Cryptographic Data Security System Utilizing Fuzzy Vault Key
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: Security is the main concern in the areas of medical, industrial, military and other fields. Including cryptography and steganography, there are various technologies available today for ensuring the trustworthy transmission of digital data. It is very important to generate strong multi-layered systems that can withstand the rapid increase in computing tool capability which may endanger security. In this paper, we have introduced a hybrid data security system that uses the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm, the Rivest-Shamir-Adleman (RSA) algorithm, Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) steganography, and the fuzzy vault key generation system for text encryption, embedding text into images, and then encrypting those images. We have employed these techniques to get privileged by their effective features, which have added an enhanced security level to this system. For encrypted image, the resulting Number of Changing Pixel rate (NPCR) value is 99.47 percent and the Unified Averaged Changed Intensity (UACI) value is 33.21 percent that are both surprisingly closer to the optimum value.

articleTitle: Impact Analysis of Body Materials for Robo-Res 2.0 & 3.0: Part of Humanoid Rescue Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: Robo-Res is experimental humanoid rescue-robot research to lead rescue operation on the impassable situations. This research represents the material-impact analysis for the design of humanoid rescue robot to meet the features of Robo-Res. Several analyses have been done to scrutinize the impact of common body materials for the leg and hand design of humanoid rescue robot. A previously developed impact testing machine has been used to experiment various materials, which includes heavy materials such as cast iron, brass, mild steel along with the soft materials such as acrylic and aluminum. “ASTM E-23” standard has been followed for the experiment. After the successful impact test, the strength and temperature effects are visible for the mentioned materials. These data will help to design not only the leg and hand design in Robo-Res 2.0 and 3.0 consecutively but also in further robotic body design for rescue purpose.

articleTitle: An Analytical Approach to Predict the COVID-19 Death Rate in Bangladesh Utilizing Multiple Regression and SEIR Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: The epidemic of COVID-19 has turned out to be a huge fear for the world. There is currently no advisable drug or cure available to treat this condition. According to WHO statistics, COVID-19 has become a progressive lung illness that is spread by respiratory droplets and other forms of contact. According to WHO, there is still no treatment or defensive plan that has risen till the period to encounter the COVID- 19 pandemic that was arisen in China in late 2019. The purpose of our study is to predict the COVID-19 situation by analyzing the death rate, recovery rate, and susceptibility rate with the help of the regression model and SEIR model. Two analytical models (SEIR and Regression) have been used. Our analysis has shown the prediction of the COVID-19 death rate in Bangladesh with the help of a Regression and SEIR model. We have analyzed the instances per million, number of death rates per million from the SEIR and Regression results and compared them with the real-time result. We have used a valid data set of Bangladesh, collected from the Institute of Epidemiology, Disease Control and Research (ICR) from 18 March 2020 to July 18, 2021. Our experimental result shows promising performance. Examples and descriptions are provided to explain the technique.

articleTitle: TOS: A Relative Metric Approach for Model Selection in Machine Learning Solutions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: One of the major tasks for a machine learning practitioner is to determine a classifier that would perform well not only on the test data but also on the unseen data from the real world in the future. Metrics to evaluate machine learning algorithms play a significant role to adopt one model from a wide range of machine learning algorithms to achieve optimal performance. Popular metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, F1 measure are greatly affected by the proportion of the majority class, sometimes provide less distinctive and discriminating value and also neglect the impact of true-negative in the outcome result. Moreover, real-world scenarios are skewed. Depending on the environment, problems can be either Type-I or Type-II error case sensitive and a particular error case has to be minimized whether the other one increases. To address this, we proposed a novel relative metric, Trade Off Score(TOS) with informativeness property, good distinctive property considering the type of sensitivity the environment holds and also immune to an imbalanced dataset. TOS provides a score based on the trade-off between accuracy and error rate according to case sensitivity. The proposed metric also quantifies model efficiency by taking into account all the model performances thus forming a relative-metric. We also evaluated our metrics from three different perspectives to justify the performance along with other metrics.

articleTitle: Suspension System Modelling And Control For An Electric Vehicle Driven by In-Wheel Motors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: The growing popularity of electric vehicles EV is mostly related with state measures aimed at selling new automobiles with reduced emissions of dangerous substances into the atmosphere. Emission standards enshrine this. The usage of in-wheel electric motors is one solution to the exhaust pollution problem. this paper evaluates the impact of an in-wheel motor IWM suspension system on the ride comfort and road holding of an electric vehicle EV. To investigate the impact of the IWM suspension system on vehicle ride comfort, a dynamic vehicle quarter model with 1-DOF is created using a combination of road surface profile excitations and in-wheel motor. To achieve the target of this paper, a complete control system is implemented; this control system is prepared using MATLAB and consists of three components: the input signals (the actuator force and the road surface profile), a fuzzy PID controller, and the suspension model. The simulation results illustrate a comparison of the suspension system's performance in two scenarios: when the standard wheel is used and when IWM is used. This study showed that the IWM used gave a negative result on the performance of the system because of its extra weight, even if this effect was small compared to the suspension system performance when using standard wheels.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study and Modern Take on Intel 8086 like Modular Trainer Board System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: Chip manufacturers design microprocessors to handle complex algorithms while still being in a very compact package. The introduction of microprocessors replaced the traditionally used bulky analog circuits while simultaneously providing scopes for further up-gradation in the algorithm without changing anything. Hence, for a student from an Electrical or Electronics background, it is essential to know about a microprocessor's working principles. Although commercially available microprocessor trainer boards provide some insight, they do not offer extended tests and diversity. Our paper represents a device, which replicates a training module for the microprocessor lab of undergraduate students of EEE. It can operate with the same code structure and logic as the Intel 8086, with an interactive interface to make the learning process a bit easier. Being a modular device, it offers compatibility with a comprehensive series of extension boards to be plugged in and ready to operate. This opens ample possibilities for creative projects involving the implementation of a microprocessor.

articleTitle: Medical Assistant Robot for Communication with Disabled Patients
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: Patients with neuromotor disorders who are unable to talk or move are in desperate need of ways to express their desires and communicate with their surroundings. As a result, one of the major challenges that have drawn the attention of many academics is finding strategies to enable these individuals to express their aspirations. The goal of this study is to create an assistant robot that patients who are unable to talk can utilize to express their requests. A sending circuit is attached to the patient's hand, while a receiving circuit is attached to the doctor or patient supervisor. The patient moves his hand at various angles, each of which corresponds to the patient's desires. The angle's value is delivered to the reception circle, which shows the angle's value as words on a display screen that reflects the patient's desire. The robot has been successfully implemented and tested in the field.

articleTitle: Smart Diaper: Non-stop Diaper Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: This paper presents the development of a smart diaper system by applying the Internet of things (IoT) concept. The smart diaper system has a wet sensor known as the wet detector unit. The central controlling unit of the wet detection system is the low-cost wireless micro-controller. The micro-controller creates a bridge between the cloud (IoT cloud) and the wet detection system. A mobile application has been developed for the convenience of end-users. All sensors data collected from Smart Diaper are presented in apps through the cloud. The wet detector sensor is placed between the inner layers of a diaper. When the wet sensor sensed any wet, it knocked the micro-controller to transmit the value to the cloud. The mobile apps pushed a notification based on the wet value. Thus the user revived a message from the system and performed the diaper change operation.

articleTitle: Designing and Implementing Robot-Web-Suite, A Cloud Based Robotics Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: This paper presents Robot-Web-Suite, a web-based platform to control your robotic devices remotely in real-time. The end-user is provided with an intuitive web interface to manipulate devices like robotic arms and mobile robots without having any prior knowledge of the kinematics of the machines. The system also provides a service to log points and achieve playback. The system has been designed to replace the usage of teach pendants or similar devices in industrial automation. Using the Robot Operating System (ROS) and the MoveIt package, the focus is on creating a hardware-agnostic system that can easily be ported to any robot.

articleTitle: A Two-Step Clustering Approach to Measure Soil Quality of Sundarban Based on Organic Carbon and Bulk Density
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: Mangrove forest is distinctive because of their unique soil particles which are essential for determining characteristics of soil as their presence influence the growth of different species. The present condition of Sundarban is not so good because of our different activities and the elements of the soil of Sundarban have changed for a different reason. In our study, we have tried to know the present soil quality of Sundarban by measuring Organic Carbon and Bulk Density after collecting data from five regions of Sundarban such as Sutarkhali, Karomjol, Herbaria, Akram Point, and Alorkol. We have used linear regression analysis and Spearman correlation method to find correlation depth between Organic Carbon & Bulk Density and a Two-Step clustering algorithm to show the area in a cluster that contains the same amount of Bulk Density and Organic Carbon. We have gotten the mean value of Bulk Density is 0.87 g/cm3 to 1.26 g/cm3, Organic Carbon is 1.03% to 2.82% and the relationship between Organic Carbon and Bulk Density is negative. Our study exhibits that, the soil of Sundarban has enough Organic Carbon for plants but lacks sufficient Bulk Density.

articleTitle: A Simple SDR based Method to Spoof Low-End GPS aided Drones for Securing Locations
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: With the advancement in the development of cost-effective Software Defined Radio technology, spoofing of GNSS aided systems has become easy and became a tool to protect both civilian and defence assests. One such system which can be threat to assests is GNSS aided drone. This paper concentrates on how the off-the shelf general purpose economical drones such as Holy Stone HS700 can be spoofed. In this work the GPS spoofing is accomplished by using GPS-SDR-SIM and HackRF One SDR. The spoofing attack on drone is successfully implemented in both static and dynamic modes. Based on the experimental results it is found that this type of drone is easily susceptible to spoofing effects. Also, the aspect of avoiding the trespassing of drones into prohibited areas is investigated. It is proved that simple economical spoofing techniques are sufficient to protect the sensitive zones from ordinary drones.

articleTitle: A comparison of Chaotic Key Sequence and Blockchain Hasher for the Privacy Protection of the Internet of Things Image Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: The internet of things (IoT) is a system that requires interconnected computing devices with unique identifiers which can perform data communications without human involvement. In an integrated network of computer systems, IoT devices such as smart cameras and image sensors play a critical role. In the internet of things, images generated by these sensors are constantly at risk of disclosure and privacy invasion (IoT). Because of the presence of third parties in IoT environments, traditional options for securing sensitive data fade. To prevent such malicious tampering image encryption system, while being safe and easy to implement provides a high level of protection to the shared media files. Among them a new image encryption has been derived using chaotic sequence. In this study, a comparison of hybrid image encryption algorithms of a chaotic system based Logical map is described to encrypt and decrypt IoT image data for security purposes using various quality measures.

articleTitle: Analysis for Solar-Powered Electric Car Development with Wireless Control Features
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: Industrial carbon emission reduction is the daily goal of greener world. In this era, car is the most used private vehicle. The combustion fuel-based cars are also the obstacle of green-earth hope. Electric Car or Electric Vehicle has become only choice for people around. Conflicting side is, the scarcity of electric charging stations. The deploying complexity and power system issues for charging station development are creating panic in people to buy dedicated Electric Vehicle (EV). As a result, drivers are depending on hybrid EVs. On the other hand, personal Electric Car (EC) can be shifted to fully Solar-Powered (SPEC). In this research, analysis for SPEC development has been carried out to analyze the entire performance and advantages. A mid-level prototype has been designed and implemented for the test procedures along with system justifications. The scrutiny has been done later, using the parameters of the prototype. In future, this analysis will assist the SPEC development plans.

articleTitle: Development of a Modern Simulation Software and Analysis of its Performance Using a Swarm System Architecture Driven by Nature-Inspired Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: Swarm robotics is a branch of robotics that deals with numerous, semi-autonomous robots to accomplish a task. A robotic swarm of unmanned drones can be configured to work as a collective, in order to carry out Search and Rescue (SAR), localization and mapping, in an efficient and cost-effective manner. Proper simulation and modelling of swarm robotics are highly essential, as it enables liability-free development and testing of a large-scale multi-agent system. The intelligence of semiautonomous agents within a swarm can be driven by nature-inspired algorithms such as Stigmergy, Flocking, and Differential Evolution. This paper serves to highlight the development of a modern multi-agent simulation platform designed to simulate a swarm of robots assigned with a task, in a procedurally generated environment, alongside a swarm system architecture where nature-inspired algorithms drive the intelligence of each agent.

articleTitle: An Approach of Implementing IoT Based Rooftop Rainwater Harvesting & Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: With the continual increment in population and severe droughts, we are facing receding water levels in urban areas. Where The water demands have only gone up, Rainwater harvesting is becoming a more important aspect of the toolset for long-term water management. Hence we have chosen an IoT-based approach to solve the issue which was missing in this particular field even though there have been some microcontroller-based approaches. With the installation of a reservoir and a few sensors, this proposal will ensure better water management for the urban areas, whether in the presence or absence of a power supply. This solves many preexisting problems like overfilling of the reservoirs as the monitoring is done at all times. As samples of our Approach-Water of all qualities, clear, opaque, and dirty were tested- and it was possible to distinguish successfully.

articleTitle: EC-5G: Edge Computing-Aware 5G Heterogeneous Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: 5G is a cellular network of the advanced generation which aims at dramatically boost service quality, such as better capacity and lower latency. The edge computing infrastructure is emergent and allows 5G to grow by the proximity of cloud resources to end-users (gadgets) so that the underlying issues of current cloud issues such as high latency and lack of security can be solved. This paper offers an overview of the advance edge computing technologies in 5G focused on aims, computational frameworks, features, 5G tasks, performance measures, and responsibilities, and includes taxonomy of 5G edge computing. Other relevant issues are also highlighted, including key criteria for efficient adoption of 5G and edge computing implementations of 5G. The authors then focused on the new advances in edge computing for 5G. This shows the excellent characteristics of numerous 5G edge computing paradigms. Finally, research issues regarding EC-5G are highlighted.

articleTitle: Detection of Potholes using Convolutional Neural Network Models: A Transfer Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: The most serious issue with the road and highway transportation system is accidental deaths. A pothole is the most prominent cause of poor road conditions, and as a result, road damage is booming in Bangladesh and throughout the world. Using image processing techniques to identify and classify potholes is a very operative term for preventing road accidents and providing a safe journey. As a result, the objective of this study is to identify the pothole using image processing techniques, which is the Transfer Learning methodology. For identifying potholes, two conventional neural network models, Visual Geometry Group (VGG16) and Residual Networks (ResNet50), were used. The major goal of this paper is to recognize potholes and furnish the Road and Highway Department (RHD) with a Computer Vision based solution. For model feeding, several image preprocessing approaches are utilized, and our suggested models achieve a considerable boost in performance, with VGG16 gaining 96.31% and ResNet50 acquiring 98.66% accuracy, respectively. As a consequence, the high accuracy of the proposed models implies that the research study is indeed successful.
